Small lives, individual rhythms

01 / CHARACTER

A role for each visitor

Patrollers travel the banks. Sentinels hold a lookout. Skimmers keep low, while wanderers take a broader path.

02 / DIRECTION

Give a gentle cue

Guide the selected individual, invite a backward dart and brake, or let six feet settle onto a twig. Its neighbours continue their own scene.

03 / STILLNESS

Watch at your pace

Choose Slow or Still, or pause at any moment. Reduced-motion preferences keep the pond still, with alternate poses to explore.

Keyboard: Tab through the controls. On the focused pond, 1–4 selects a visitor, arrow keys guide it, D darts backward, L lands, R relaunches, and Space pauses. Touch: tap a dragonfly to select and guide it, or use the labelled controls. Flight cues apply to the selected visitor; scrolling stays available.
